name: Jauml
reason: Required library: hard dependency of RPG Stats (RAS) and The Eclipsed Realm, and (per their mods.toml) of The Witch Hut and The Gingerbread House. Adds no content.
config_files: none of its own (each dependent mod writes config/<mod>/...)

name: Remnants | RPG Stats, Skills & Progression (RPG Attribute System, "RAS")
reason: Hub of the Remnants family: player RPG level + Valor Points (VP) from kills, 8 data-driven attributes, level-up screen (K). RPG Mobs, Runeborn, Skills and Powers, Fellowship and Roguelite Dungeons all hook into it. Runeborn shrine level-ups require it by default.
commands: /ras ... (level, points, xp, stats, reset, reload subcommands exist in the jar; see docs/commands/command-reference.md in the GitHub repo)
config_files: mob_xp.json, respec.json, templates.json (names from jar strings; same ras config tree)

name: Runeborn | Soulslike RPG progression
reason: The soulslike core: runes dropped on death, Ember Shrines (rest/level/travel/respawn), 8 souls attributes, 74 scaling armaments, weapon arts, stamina + dodge roll, 7 summonable Sovereign bosses, Codex. Pairs with RAS by design. Needs config + key rebinds to coexist with RPG Mobs and Skills and Powers.

name: Remnants | RPG Mobs
reason: Mob levels (distance/days/depth/structures/RAS level), 5 ranks incl. named "Remnant" mini-bosses, 16 traits, soulslike nameplates with health bars, Hunter's Moon event, Remnant Shards -> Valor. Already integrates with RAS, Eclipsed Realm and Roguelite Dungeons. Turn Runeborn's own mob levels off to avoid double scaling.

name: Remnants | The Eclipsed Realm (mod id remnant_bosses, "Remnant Bosses")
reason: Endgame centrepiece: the Eclipsed Realm dimension (7 biomes, build-protected), Waygate portal, Grace Embers (rest/respawn/fast travel), 3 arena bosses + Ossukage, 5 creature families, boss gear sets, Boss Hunts Journal. Note the entity namespace is remnants:, items/blocks are remnant_bosses:.

name: Remnants: Roguelite Dungeons (mod id tbos, formerly The Birth of Steve)
reason: Story-ready: authored prologue (Fracture Shrines, Meridian Archive puzzles, the Last Curator) plus repeatable Memory Key expeditions in the procedural Fractured Archive dimension with parties, Relics, Codex insights and a Weekly run. Its memory/forgetting theme matches the Eclipsed Realm. All-Rights-Reserved licence (reference the file; do not re-host the jar). Heavy keybind overlap (R/G/V/K/J/N).
commands: op: /expedition key, /expedition weekly_key, /expedition relic, /codex renown, /codex reset

name: Remnants | Skills and Powers (mod id elementals, formerly Elementals)
reason: Path-of-Exile style 522-node passive tree, 6 schools, 30 cast abilities on R/Z/B/H, 12 keystones, Essence resource; skill points come from RAS levels when RAS is present. Strong, but it duplicates Runeborn's FP spells/weapon arts and Iron's Spells, adds a third resource bar and collides with Runeborn (I, R), Minimap (B) and Wands (R, Z). Include only if the pack wants an explicit skill-tree layer, and rebind keys.
commands: /powers (alias /skills): info, build codes (/powers build), points, levels, xp, resets, origins, grant nodes, clear cooldowns, cast, reload
config_files: general.json (config folder name not visible in the jar)

name: Remnants | Fellowship (mod id better_with_gold, formerly Better With Gold)
reason: Hire named sellswords for gold ingots; 5 classes, 11 traits, morale, downed-not-dead revives, command wheel, formations, Warbanner and a per-ally Chronicle - strong story hooks. Lower partySize (default 6) for soulslike difficulty. No custom currency (vanilla gold, configurable).

name: Mob LootBags
reason: Six-tier bags from kills (Common..Mythic), special bags, Bag Opener / Loot Recycler machines, bad-luck protection, boss drops. Works with RPG Mobs, but stacks a third reward layer on ranked kills and its default tables (nether stars, beacons, maxed netherite in Mythic) undercut curated soulslike loot. Include only with re-tuned tables.

name: Much More Dungeons
reason: 4 handcrafted dungeons + 6 jigsaw labyrinths, tiered loot, named vanilla-mob guardians and a treasure-map trail Tier I -> IV - ready-made quest chain. Vanilla blocks only, no items/entities. Overlaps YUNG's Better Dungeons/When Dungeons Arise only in theme.

name: Fisherman's Coast (mod id fisherman_house)
reason: Seven shore-aware structures with named fisher NPCs (vanilla villagers), Crab Pots, nets, baits and Messages in a Bottle (12 sea notes) that lead to Sunken Trawlers - cheap exploration + lore hooks, no conflicts.

name: Remnants | Advanced Minimap & Waypoints (mod id remnantminimaps, formerly Odyssey Map)
reason: Client-only Elden Ring style parchment minimap/world map with Site of Grace emblems, bloodstains at death, beacons and pillars of light. Replaces Xaero's/JourneyMap (do not ship both). Rebind N (clashes with Roguelite Codex) and B (Skills and Powers cast 3). No integration with the Grace/Shrine blocks of other mods (markers are manual).

name: Smart Villagers AI (mod id smartvillagers)
reason: Talkative villagers with fetch/slay requests, reputation and gossip; works with built-in dialogue and no AI key. Useful as filler side-quests, but LLM-written dialogue can contradict an authored story, AI use needs provider keys and per-player consent. If included, leave provider unset or lock personas.
config_files: secrets.toml, consent.json, ledger.json (names from jar strings)

name: RE:Constructed Wands
reason: Good building wands with undo and claim checks, but off-theme for a soulslike and its default keys (R wheel, G screen, Ctrl+Z/Y) collide with Runeborn/Skills and Powers/Fellowship/Roguelite; include only if building matters, after rebinding.

name: Better Farming ++ (mod id better_farming_plus)
reason: Right-click/hoe-sweep harvest, Sprinkler, Farming Crate, no trampling, harvest indicators. Harmless QoL, no NightBeam overlap; overlaps Farmer's Delight only in right-click harvesting of vanilla-style crops.

name: Sprout & Soil
reason: Unfinished on 1.21.1: 3 crops (tomato, garlic, "letuce") with no foods, crop stages are plain blocks (not CropBlock), and its block loot tables and only recipe ship in the pre-1.21 folders data/*/loot_tables and data/*/recipes, which 1.21.1 ignores - crops drop nothing and seeds cannot be crafted. Farmer's Delight covers tomatoes.

name: The Witch Hut (mod id better_witch_huts)
reason: One static vanilla-block hut (swamp, dark forest, plains) with a witch spawner and fixed contents (iron, emeralds). Adds a NEW structure; does not replace the vanilla swamp hut. The page's trader witches / random loot are not in the jar. Needs jauml. Low priority; YUNG's Better Witch Huts is the stronger choice.

name: The Gingerbread House (mod id christmas_ginger_house)
reason: Festive candy house (snowy biomes + plains) with fixed vanilla contents (bread, snowballs, potatoes); tone-breaking for a dark soulslike. Needs jauml.

name: Genetically Modified Monsters (mod id gmm)
reason: Only 7 red mutant creeper variants (leap, climb, hunter, adaptive, silent, swift, overcharge up to 2x charged-creeper blasts) - "lab-engineered" theme, terrain-griefing explosions, spawn eggs ship without item models. RPG Mobs traits already give creepers variety.

name: Chronofall (formerly Robotica / The Year 3001)
reason: Year-3001 sci-fi (laser Sentinels, jetpacks, mechs, hover skiffs, rift gates, pulse rifles) breaks the dark-fantasy tone; jetpack/skiff flight and cross-dimension rift gates trivialise exploration and the Realm.

name: Remnants | Ballistics (CurseForge only)
reason: Sixteen modern firearms (pistols to railgun) - tone-breaking for a soulslike; 0.4.0 is a beta pre-release, CurseForge-only (no Modrinth/mrpack hash), needs NeoForge 21.1.264+, injects into 25 vanilla loot tables and binds R/V/I.
config_files: NeoForge config specs (client/common/server); exact file names not visible in the jar

name: Core Utilities
reason: FE generators, cables, crusher/alloy smelter, quarry, mob grinder, item pipes, backpacks. Off-theme, and quarry + mob grinder undercut exploration and the RPG Mobs / loot reward loop.

name: Simple Terminals
reason: Single Crafting Terminal block that reads an attached chest / Sophisticated Storage controller. Harmless QoL; only one storage-terminal solution is needed (skip if AE2/RS/Sophisticated Storage terminals are used).

name: No More 63 AE2
reason: Only changes AE2's 63-types-per-cell cap; hard-requires AE2 [19.2.17,20.0.0) (not declared on Modrinth). Exclude unless AE2 is in the pack, then optional.
